task.title: Register and run the existing Teaching worker to a terminal session

scope.owned_layer: Training-session preview/evaluation job intent, existing worker terminalization, persisted session readback, and Learning-verifier identifier output.
not_changing: shared loop catalog or controller maturity declarations
persona target commit decisions or live execution

implementation.strategy: Reuse preview_eval_worker.py. The queue contract carries an opt-in terminalize_session intent; a completed job with that intent calls the existing completion API and then verifies the persisted session through the existing GET API.
implementation.normal_preview_compatibility: terminalize_session defaults false, so ordinary preview jobs remain preview-only and leave active trainer sessions open.
implementation.failure_semantics: Completion or readback HTTP errors, identity mismatch, non-terminal status, or missing ended_at increment worker failure and suppress the terminal identifier.

limitations: The proof uses ephemeral local file persistence, not hosted Postgres HA.
The source DatasetVersion and threshold policy are bounded development authorities generated under a temporary directory.
The persona target pre-read boundary is a test double; this task does not perform persona commit.
Actual Learning consumption, shared catalog registration, Compose activation, and hosted proof belong to downstream M2/M3/M4 tasks.

commands.conclusion: focused worker and service lifecycle tests pass
